title: An Ember in the Fist
summary: Captain Garrow's ledger says robed strangers paid him forty crowns to dig at the Sunken Chapel. Osric Hale wants to know who is paying, and what anyone could want from a chapel the river has half eaten.

steps.journal: Go down to the second floor of the Sunken Chapel, in the marsh past the lumber camp. Find the robed stranger who pays for the digging, and stop him.

ready: The robed stranger died holding something warm. Take it to Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember in Thornwick.
done: Sister Ilse has the warm shard from the Sunken Chapel: an ember-shard made in the fens. Act I is done.
